verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe hybrid search combining vector and BM25-based full-text search with reranking to fuse results (lancedb-docs-3, lancedb-docs-39, lancedb-docs-40, lancedb-docs-25, lancedb-docs-4), and FTS index creation via create_fts_index alongside vector search is shown as part of the hybrid workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of fusion ranking quality/behavior beyond vendor docs, and detail on which fusion algorithms (e.g., RRF) are configurable.
